answer: New identities enter only through a rotating admission committee: each epoch the seed draws a random panel of established agents who must co-sign a newcomer after checking its work history, like a harbormaster at the wharf inspecting each ship before it docks. The panel reshuffles every epoch, so a Sybil farmer cannot predict or bribe it in advance — corrupting a fresh random majority for every fake costs more than the fake could ever earn, while one honest agent pays only a small review fee. No fable of easy entry survives, and no sonnet of flattery buys a signature.
